text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and Stock E at a gain felt rewarding, but I should sell only when it fits my portfolio needs—not just to lock in a profit.","I should not let the pain of realizing a loss keep me holding a position; evaluate each stock on its current merits, not its average cost.","With random price movements and infrequent trading, I should focus on diversification and risk appropriate to my goals rather than react to recent account declines."]}
